title: docs(qa): start QA rounds on the maintainer's word and add the scenario half
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb9R81zJBEnwtS9WxYnDKFP7)_

Fixes #31434

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：QA 席不再按每周定时跑，改为你说「一波开发完了」才开一轮；每轮在清单回归之外加跑场景库的 `starter` 卡（用本仓未发布的包）。
- 为什么改：照你在 QA 席会话里的两句裁决「也不需要每周跑，一波开发完了，我会和你说」与「纳入，本轮一起跑，立卡交 skills 车道」。
- 风险与回滚：只改三份内部规则文本，不动任何脚本、选择器（`owed:weekly` 原样）或产品代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md`（〈每轮〉新增四行场景半边）、`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §6、`lanes/skills.md` 第 25 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`，预期三份文件行数都在上限内、全绿（qa.md 29/29，SKILL.md 279/279，skills.md 32/33）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（Tier S，契约复审归总监席）。

## What changes

- `lanes/qa.md` 〈座位与唤醒〉: the weekly Routine fire is gone; a round opens when the maintainer says a development wave is done, and a post-release round still runs the npm smoke. The "first round, then every fire" line is removed (its content is the next section's first line).
- `lanes/qa.md` 〈每轮〉: the scenario half, four lines: the `starter` cards of `docs/qa/scenarios` with `--modes scratch --packages workspace` (a wave is unreleased); one card per command (`--only ID`, the 2-hour background cap) and at most two in parallel per container, citing `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` 〈Running the cards in a Claude Code cloud session〉 for the subscription `oauth_token` login, the two API variables left unset and a permission mode other than Auto (named, not restated); the scorecard goes in the round report, not a `qa-run` record; a failing half judged a product defect is extracted like a checklist `fail`, its `QA-source:` line pointing at the round.
- `lanes/qa.md` 〈边界〉: a QA wave (release-candidate full run, maintainer-named target) stays maintainer-triggered and distinct from the wave-end rounds; the seat runs the section 6 routines plus the scenario half.
- `checklist-test` section 6 points at `lanes/qa.md` for when a round opens (one written copy of the cadence); "weekly / last week" become "routine / last round" in section 6 and in retest trigger 4 of section 5.
- `lanes/skills.md` line 25: the section 6 routines and the scenario half run per development wave and are not a QA wave.

Line budget, paid inside each file (no re-wrap): `qa.md` 29 → 29 (four scenario lines paid by deleting the first-round line, folding the `retest-owed` line into the four-record line, and replacing the three restated section 5 lines on closing and Supersede with one pointer); `checklist-test/SKILL.md` 279 → 279; `lanes/skills.md` 32 → 32. Every changed line is at most 120 bytes.

Facts checked against `main` before writing: the six `starter` cards are the top-level `tier` of `asset_lifecycle`, `leave_balances`, `order_to_cash`, `requisition_to_receipt`, `service_desk` and `travel_expense`; `--only`, `--modes scratch` and `--packages workspace` are parsed in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts`; the API-billing refusal is `API_BILLING_ENV` in `driver.ts`. No script reads `owed:weekly` (`git grep` hits only the two rule files), so no selector moves.

## Why

The maintainer's two rulings quoted above, recorded on the card.
